author: CoolVision
description:
I spent 24 hours inside Harare, Zimbabwe’s capital. In this travel documentary, we explore the incredible economic contrasts of this overlooked African capital—from the luxury mansions of Borrowdale to the relentless hustle of the Mbare street markets. Is Harare truly the most misunderstood city in Africa? Let's find out.
